title: Vienna Rising Again
author: Oscar Iversen
blurb: Cyrus Ishikawa, a hostage negotiator with one failure still on the board, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. But when a burner phone that shouldn't exist starts ringing with a familiar voice on the line, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must extract a defector who may be the bait before the extraction flight leaves at dawn.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
